title: NAS signalling using trusted WLAN access network

entities.name: Trusted WLAN Interworking Function
entities.description: Provides functionalities for non-5G capable over WLAN (N5CW) devices to access 5GCN, including NAS signalling and PDU session management.

entities.name: Non-5G Capable over WLAN Device
entities.description: A device that accesses 5GCN via the TWIF using WLAN access, with limited 5G capabilities.

entities.name: Registration Procedure
entities.description: TWIF registers on behalf of the N5CW device to an AMF using implementation-specific default values.

entities.name: PDU Session Establishment
entities.description: TWIF may request to establish a PDU session on behalf of the N5CW device upon receipt of an IP configuration request.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU Session Release
entities.description: TWIF initiates PDU session release upon loss of the IP address of the N5CW device.

entities.name: Single PDU Session Support
entities.description: Only one PDU session is supported when N5CW device accesses 5GC via the TWIF.

entities.name: IP Configuration Request
entities.description: Trigger for TWIF to establish a PDU session on behalf of the N5CW device.

entities.name: Loss of IP Address
entities.description: Condition that triggers the TWIF to initiate PDU session release.

relations.description: TWIF acts on behalf of the N5CW device for registration and PDU session management.
TWIF performs registration on behalf of the N5CW device.
TWIF may request PDU session establishment upon IP configuration request.
IP configuration request triggers PDU session establishment.
TWIF initiates PDU session release upon IP address loss.
Loss of IP address triggers PDU session release.
Only one PDU session is supported for N5CW device via TWIF.
